notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight or Merfolk.
easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a counter on another Knight or Merfolk you control.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.
